regions.name: Willowbrook
regions.description: A little town gathered around Professor Fern’s laboratory. Garden paths connect the houses, practice meadow, and old Waystone.
regions.greeting: Welcome to Willowbrook! Choose a companion, then meet me beside the town square. The laboratory is open if your team needs care.
regions.hook: The laboratory’s old map has begun to show trails beyond the valley.

regions.name: Whisperwood Trail
regions.description: A winding woodland trail curls between dense trees, fern clearings, and a ranger cabin. Follow the bends to find the forest’s hidden glade.
regions.greeting: Welcome to Whisperwood. Stay curious at the bends! My cabin is a good place to rest before another woodland encounter.
regions.hook: Tiny footprints lead from the ranger cabin into a clearing where the trees seem to listen.

regions.name: Cloverbank River
regions.description: Flower meadows slope toward a winding river. A timber bridge links the western rest house with the broad eastern riverbank.
regions.greeting: The bridge is safe, and our rest house has room for your companions. Take a moment to hear the water before you set out.
regions.hook: Someone has tied a ribbon to the bridge; a matching ribbon drifts past every morning.

objects.text: The current runs swiftly below the bridge.

regions.name: Waystone Terraces
regions.description: Broken stone terraces rise through moss and wild grass. Zigzag paths lead between an archive shelter, fallen pillars, and a weathered shrine.
regions.greeting: These terraces have welcomed travelers for generations. The archive shelter offers care, and the stones have more stories than I can count.
regions.hook: A missing inscription has appeared on the Waystone, but nobody remembers carving it.

regions.name: Sunbreak Coast
regions.description: The forest gives way to open water. Long wooden boardwalks connect the shore station, sea lookout, and the routes beyond the bay.
regions.greeting: Welcome to the coast! Our station is just inland. The boardwalk lets us watch the sea without disturbing the Pokémon below.
regions.hook: At low tide, a distant bell answers footsteps on the boardwalk.
